content.equation:
Actual Elimination Rate Constant (Ke)
Ke = [ln(Cp ÷ Ctr)] ÷ (Ttr - Tp)
Cp = measured peak level drawn
Tp = hours after dose started to infuse (usually shortly after end of infusion)
Ctr = measured trough level drawn
Ttr = hours after dose started to infuse (usually shortly before next dose)
Half-Life (t)
t = 0.693 ÷ Ke
Ke = elimination rate constant (hour -1)
Volume of Distribution (Vd)
Vd = (MD ÷ T) x [1 - e(-Ke x T)] ÷ (Ke x [Cp ÷ e(-Ke x T1) - Ctr x e(-Ke x T2)])
MD = current maintenance dose
T = infusion time in hours
Ke = elimination rate constant
Cp = measured peak level drawn
Ctr = measured trough level drawn
T1 = time between end of infusion and measured peak level (Tp - T)
T2 = time between measured trough level and next dose (tau - Ttr)
Suggested Interval (tau)
tau = [ln(Cdp ÷ Cdtr) ÷ Ke] + T
Cdp = desired peak
Cdtr = desired trough
Ke = elimination rate constant
T = infusion time in hours
Note: Suggested dosing interval rounded to 8, 12, 18, 24, 36, 48, 72 hours
Suggested Dose (MD)
MD = T x Ke x Vd x Cdp x [1 - e(-Ke x tau)] ÷ [1 - e(-Ke x T)]
T = infusion time in hours
Ke = elimination rate constant
Vd = volume of distribution in L
Cdp = desired peak in mg/L
tau = suggested interval
Note: Suggested dose rounded to nearest 250 mg

content.instructions: To perform a calculation, enter the required variables. Once all the inputs are entered, click the "Calculate" button to perform the calculation. Any time an input variable is adjusted, the "Calculate" button must be clicked to populate the new output. To start over, click the "Reset" button to clear all values and begin the calculation again. Examples for Inputting Patient Information Patient information: Lab results: Peak: 45 mcg/mL; trough: 20 mcg/mL Dose administered at 0900; peak level drawn at 1100; trough level drawn at 2000 Infusion time: 1.5 hours; current dose: 1500 mg; current interval: 12 hours Desired peak: 35 mcg/mL; desired trough: 15 mcg/mL How to input into calculator: Measured peak level (Cp): Enter 45 mcg/mL. Hrs after start of dose (Tp): Enter 2 hours (1100 - 0900). Measured trough level (Ctr): Enter 20 mcg/mL. Hrs after start of dose (Ttr): Enter 11 hours (2000 - 0900). Infusion time (T): Select 1.5 hours from drop down list. Current dosing interval (tau): Enter 12 hours. Current dose (MD): Enter 1500 mg. Desired peak (Cdp): Enter 35 mcg/mL. Desired trough (Cdtr): Enter 15 mcg/mL. Detail: Select show if you would like Ke, half-life, Vd, calculated dose, and calculated interval to display along with suggested dose and interval. Select hide if you just want suggested dose and interval to display. Click calculate. These calculations are only estimates and clinical judgment must be used.
